messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. This is a fun creative challenge. I need to think about how to compose this scene using SVG elements.

Let me plan the composition:
- A bicycle (two wheels with spokes, frame, handlebars, seat)
- A pelican sitting on the seat, pedaling
- The pelican should have distinctive features: large beak with pouch, wings, body

I'll go for a cartoon-ish, charming style. Let me think about the layout:
- Canvas: maybe 600x500
- Wheels at bottom, frame connecting them
- Pelican body on top, beak extending forward

Let me draft the SVG:

Wheels: circles at roughly (150, 400) and (420, 400), radius ~70
Frame: lines connecting wheel centers to a top tube, seat tube, etc.
Handlebars: extending from the front fork upward
Seat: small rectangle/ellipse at top of seat tube

Pelican:
- Body: oval shape sitting on the seat
- Neck: curving up from body
- Head: circle
- Beak: long triangular shape with a pouch (the distinctive feature)
- Wing: maybe one wing reaching toward handlebars
- Legs/feet: pedaling on the crank/pedal area

Let me make it colorful and playful. I'll use a simple side view.

Let me code this up carefully.
answer:
```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 550">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="sky" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#87CEEB"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B0E0E6"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sky -->
  <rect width="700" height="550" fill="url(#sky)"/>

  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="460" width="700" height="90" fill="#8B7355"/>
  <rect x="0" y="460" width="700" height="5" fill="#6B5335"/>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="620" cy="60" r="40" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- Clouds -->
  <g opacity="0.8">
    <ellipse cx="120" cy="70" rx="45" ry="25" fill="white"/>
    <ellipse cx="155" cy="60" rx="40" ry="28" fill="white"/>
    <ellipse cx="90" cy="65" rx="35" ry="22" fill="white"/>
  </g>
  <g opacity="0.6">
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="45" rx="35" ry="20" fill="white"/>
    <ellipse cx="380" cy="38" rx="30" ry="18" fill="white"/>
  </g>

  <!-- === BICYCLE === -->

  <!-- Wheels -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" fill="none">
    <!-- Rear wheel -->
    <circle cx="180" cy="420" r="65" stroke="#222"/>
    <!-- Front wheel -->
    <circle cx="480" cy="420" r="65" stroke="#222"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Spokes -->
  <g stroke="#666" stroke-width="1.5">
    <!-- Rear spokes -->
    <line x1="180" y1="355" x2="180" y2="485"/>
    <line x1="115" y1="420" x2="245" y2="420"/>
    <line x1="134" y1="374" x2="226" y2="466"/>
    <line x1="134" y1="466" x2="226" y2="374"/>
    <!-- Front spokes -->
    <line x1="480" y1="355" x2="480" y2="485"/>
    <line x1="415" y1="420" x2="545" y2="420"/>
    <line x1="434" y1="374" x2="526" y2="466"/>
    <line x1="434" y1="466" x2="526" y2="374"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Wheel hubs -->
  <circle cx="180" cy="420" r="10" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="480" cy="420" r="10" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- Frame -->
  <g stroke="#E63946" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
    <!-- Rear dropout to seat tube top -->
    <line x1="180" y1="420" x2="280" y2="310"/>
    <!-- Seat tube top to bottom bracket -->
    <line x1="280" y1="310" x2="310" y2="420"/>
    <!-- Bottom bracket to rear dropout -->
    <line x1="310" y1="420" x2="180" y2="420"/>
    <!-- Top tube: seat tube top to head tube -->
    <line x1="280" y1="310" x2="440" y2="300"/>
    <!-- Down tube: head tube to bottom bracket -->
    <line x1="440" y1="300" x2="310" y2="420"/>
    <!-- Fork: head tube to front dropout -->
    <line x1="440" y1="300" x2="480" y2="420"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Handlebars -->
  <g stroke="#555" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="440" y1="300" x2="440" y2="260"/>
    <path d="M440,260 Q460,245 475,255" fill="none"/>
    <path d="M440,260 Q420,245 405,255" fill="none"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Handlebar grips -->
  <circle cx="475" cy="255" r="6" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="405" cy="255" r="6" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- Seat post and saddle -->
  <line x1="280" y1="310" x2="275" y2="280" stroke="#555" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="275" cy="275" rx="25" ry="12" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- Crank and pedals -->
  <circle cx="310" cy="420" r="15" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="310" y1="420" x2="340" y2="440" stroke="#555" stroke-width="4"/>
  <rect x="335" y="436" width="18" height="6" rx="2" fill="#333"/>
  <line x1="310" y1="420" x2="280" y2="400" stroke="#555" stroke-width="4"/>
  <rect x="268" y="396" width="18" height="6" rx="2" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- Chain -->
  <path d="M190,420 Q250,408 310,420 Q370,432 310,420" fill="none" stroke="#777" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>

  <!-- === PELICAN === -->

  <!-- Tail feathers -->
  <g fill="#F5E6CA">
    <path d="M220,280 Q190,260 175,275 Q180,285 220,280Z"/>
    <path d="M215,285 Q185,270 170,285 Q178,295 215,285Z"/>
    <path d="M225,275 Q195,250 180,262 Q188,278 225,275Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Pelican body -->
  <ellipse cx="270" cy="290" rx="50" ry="35" fill="#F5E6CA"/>
  <ellipse cx="270" cy="295" rx="45" ry="25" fill="#FFF8E7"/>

  <!-- Wing reaching to handlebars -->
  <g>
    <path d="M260,275 Q340,240 405,258 Q380,265 340,270 Q300,268 260,275Z" fill="#F5E6CA" stroke="#E8D5B5" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- Wing feathers -->
    <path d="M340,268 L345,255" stroke="#E8D5B5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M355,265 L360,252" stroke="#E8D5B5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M370,262 L375,250" stroke="#E8D5B5" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M290,280 Q310,260 320,230 Q330,200 340,185" stroke="#F5E6CA" stroke-width="18" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M290,280 Q310,260 320,230 Q330,200 340,185" stroke="#FFF8E7" stroke-width="10" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="345" cy="170" rx="18" ry="16" fill="#F5E6CA"/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="350" cy="165" r="4" fill="#222"/>
  <circle cx="351.5" cy="164" r="1.5" fill="white"/>

  <!-- Crest / small feather tuft -->
  <path d="M340,152 Q345,145 348,148 Q344,155 340,152Z" fill="#E8D5B5"/>

  <!-- === BEAK (the big feature!) === -->
  <!-- Upper beak -->
  <path d="M358,168 Q430,155 480,162 Q430,168 358,172Z" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <!-- Lower beak + pouch -->
  <path d="M358,172 Q430,168 480,162 Q430,172 420,185 Q400,200 370,195 Q358,185 358,172Z" fill="#FFA040"/>
  <!-- Pouch lines -->
  <path d="M370,190 Q400,195 420,182" stroke="#E88A30" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M365,185 Q395,192 415,178" stroke="#E88A30" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Beak ridge -->
  <line x1="358" y1="168" x2="480" y2="162" stroke="#E88A30" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- === PELICAN LEGS (pedaling!) === -->
  <!-- Leg from body to pedal -->
  <path d="M265,315 Q280,350 340,440" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Webbed foot on front pedal -->
  <path d="M335,440 L355,445 L350,455 L340,452 Z" fill="#FF8C00"/>

  <!-- Other leg hint -->
  <path d="M255,315 Q260,360 275,398" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M270,398 L290,402 L285,410 L275,407 Z" fill="#FF8C00"/>

  <!-- Helmet (safety first!) -->
  <path d="M330,155 Q345,142 360,152 Q365,158 360,162 Q345,158 330,155Z" fill="#E63946"/>
  <path d="M332,155 Q345,145 358,154" stroke="#C1303C" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Scarf trailing -->
  <path d="M325,195 Q310,200 305,220 Q310,225 315,215 Q320,205 325,195Z" fill="#457B9D"/>
  <path d="M310,220 Q300,235 295,250" stroke="#457B9D" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M310,220 Q305,238 298,255" stroke="#6A9FB5" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Speed lines -->
  <g stroke="#555" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.4" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="60" y1="200" x2="100" y2="200"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="230" x2="95" y2="230"/>
    <line x1="65" y1="260" x2="105" y2="260"/>
    <line x1="55" y1="350" x2="95" y2="350"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="380" x2="80" y2="380"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Dust clouds behind -->
  <g fill="#D4A574" opacity="0.5">
    <circle cx="120" cy="455" r="12"/>
    <circle cx="105" cy="465" r="15"/>
    <circle cx="95" cy="450" r="10"/>
    <circle cx="85" cy="460" r="8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small flowers on ground -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="550" cy="480" r="4" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
    <circle cx="550" cy="480" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="500" r="4" fill="#9B59B6"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="500" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
    <circle cx="600" cy="495" r="4" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
    <circle cx="600" cy="495" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  </g>
</svg>
```

This SVG features a cheerful pelican pedaling a red bicycle across a sunny landscape! Key details include:

- 🐦 **Distinctive pelican features**: large orange beak with a pouch, cream-colored body, wing gripping the handlebars
- 🚲 **Full bicycle**: spoked wheels, diamond frame, saddle, crank/pedals
- 🎬 **Fun extras**: a red helmet, a trailing blue scarf, speed lines, and dust clouds
- ☀️ **Scene**: sky gradient, sun, clouds, ground with flowers
